usedFor: GoDaddy Payments holds store transactions, and Moco receives follow-up work through “Create Task” after “New Transaction Completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transaction Completed” in GoDaddy Payments, then “Create Task” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: A completed sale becomes a task inside a Moco project, so the follow-up is tracked.

watchOut: “Create Task” in Moco creates the task inside a project, so choose the project, and “New Transaction Completed” is polling.
